Rem (rem, MG/Supporter/Water/Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 300, reloadFrames 171, hitsPerShot 1, normalMult 5.57 / coreMult 200, critRate 15 / critDamage 150). A Supporter whose personal damage is secondary to her Rocket-Launcher team amp; the damage-relevant lines are her OWN burst-window self-buffs (Demon's Breath crit + the Demon's-Breath-gated ATK stack) and her RL-scoped burst grants (flat ATK + max ammo). MODELED: (BUa) burst self Critical Rate ▲37.8% for 10s = critRatePct 37.8 (burstCast, self) — this IS the 'Demon's Breath' status; (BUa-gate) the burst inflicts targetStatus 'Demon's Breath' on the boss for 10s — the gauntlet-validated SELF-status proxy (asuka-wille/marciana/privaty pattern: the engine has no requiresOwnBuff/self-status gate, so the personal Demon's Breath window is mirrored as a name-keyed boss status that only HER requiresTargetStatus reads); (S1a) 'after landing 15 normal attacks in Demon's Breath status → self ATK ▲4.22%, stacks ×30, 10s' = hitCount:15 + requiresTargetStatus 'Demon's Breath' + self atkPct 4.22 maxStacks 30 durationSec 10 — the gate confines stack accrual to the 10s Demon's Breath window each 20s cycle (the hitCount counter still wraps out-of-window but applyBlock is gated out, so no stacks accrue there — faithful to 'in Demon's Breath status'); (BUb) burst 'all RL allies ATK ▲50.78% of the skill user's ATK for 10s' = casterAtkPct 50.78 (burstCast, alliesOfWeapon RL, 10s) — resolved flat ATK = 50.78% of Rem's static ATK, tove-proven path; (BUc) burst 'all RL allies Max Ammunition Capacity ▲5 rounds for 10s' = maxAmmoFlat 5 (burstCast, alliesOfWeapon RL, 10s). UNMODELED (all three are HEALING / HP-redistribution, damage-inert in v1 — no HP pool, boss deals no damage, and Rem has no recovery-triggered block; the 'Equally shares HP recovery' mechanic is a heal-REDISTRIBUTION, not a plain heal, so encoding a plain `heal` would misrepresent it, and lifesteal has no primitive): S1b burst-cast HP-recovery share to all allies (10s); S2a self lifesteal 42.24% of attack damage (continuous); S2b HP-recovery share to self + 2 highest-final-ATK RL allies (continuous).
